title: Quentin and the Locker
author: Ines Voss
blurb: Petra Dunmore, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
